INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.

2. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid speaking to classmates
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   D. Mix random languages with no purpose

3. When practising Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Public speaking – Impromptu speech, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Public speaking – Impromptu speech.

   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Public speaking – Impromptu speech.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Public speaking – Impromptu speech.

   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading for comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading for comprehension.

6. When practising Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading.

----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Public speaking – Impromptu speech and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 4.2.1 Reading for information – Poetry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
